paite: Jesu'n mipite leh anungzuite kiang ah thu agen hi.
heading: Laigelhmite Leh Pharisaite Demna / (Mar 12.38-39; Luk 11.43,46; 20.45-46)
english: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,

paite: “Mosi tutphah ah laigelhmite leh Pharisaite atu uhi.
english: saying, “The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses’ seat.

paite: Huaiziak in ahon hilh peuhmah uh hih unla zui zel un; amau thilhih bang zaw hih tuan kei un, gen zaw agen ua, ahih tuan kei uh.
english: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don’t do their works; for they say, and don’t do.

paite: Puakgik haksatak abawl ua, mite asuan ua, amau lah akhutzung un leng akhoih nuam kei uh.
english: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them.

paite: Athilhih tengteng uh mihing muh ding in ahi, ahih zawk uh, athil buh uleh akhipte uh aliansak ua, apuan mongkai uh asausak ua,
english: But they do all their works to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad and enlarge the fringes of their garments,

paite: ankuangluina ah mun hoihpen leh sinagogte ah tutphah hoihpen leh,
english: and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,

paite: dawr mun a chibai buk leh mi'n, 'Rabbi, Rabbi,' achih bang uh adeihtuamse uhi.
english: the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called ‘Rabbi, Rabbi’ by men.

paite: Nou zaw, Rabbi chih in om kei un; sinsakpa khat na nei ua, nou tengteng unaute na hi uhi.
english: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi’, for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.

paite: Huan leitung ah kuamah Pa, chi kei un; na Pa uh khat kia van a om ahi.
english: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.

paite: Heutute chih in om sam kei un, heutu khat na nei ua amah Khrist ahi.
english: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.

paite: Na lak ua thupipen na sikha ua a-om zawk ding ahi.
english: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant.

paite: Kuapeuh kiliansak adai ding, kuapeuh kingaineu pahtawi in a-om ding hi.
english: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.

paite: "Himahleh nou laigelhmi leh Pharisai lepchiahte aw, na tung uh agik hi; van-gam lampi mite na khaksak ngal ua; nou lah na lut ngal kei uh, mi alut dingte lut ding leng na phal kei zel uh.
heading: Pharisaite Lepchiahna Mohpaihna / (Mar 12.40; Luk 11.39-42; 11.44,52; 20.47)
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows’ houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.

paite: Laigelhmi leh Pharisai lepchiahte aw, na tung uh agik hi; meithai innte na negai ngal ua, thumna saupi mi khemna ding in na nei ua, huaiziak in mohna liansem na mu ding uhi.
english: “But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you don’t enter in yourselves, neither do you allow those who are entering in to enter.

paite: "Nou laigelhmi leh Pharisai lepchiahte aw, na tung uh agik hi; phungkai khat lel bawl ding in tuipi leh gam na pai kimvel ngal ua, huchibang a ahong omtak in, amah noumau lehnih in gawtmun ta in na bawl uhi.
english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of Gehenna as yourselves.

paite: "Nou makai mittaw, kuapeuh tempul lou a kichiam bangmah ahi kei; kuapeuh tempul a dangka-eng lou a kichiam zaw tangtunsak ding ahi chite aw, na tung uh agik hi.
english: “Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.’

paite: Nou mihai leh mittawte aw; abang pen athupizaw a, dangka-eng hia, ahihkeileh dangka-eng siangthousak tempul?
english: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold?

paite: Kuapeuh maitam lou a kichiam bangmah ahi kei; atung a thilpiak om lou a kichiam in atangtunsak ding ahi, na chi uh.
english: And, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obligated.’

paite: Nou mittawte aw, abang athupizaw a, thilpiak hia thilpiak siangthousak maitam?
english: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?

paite: Huchi in 'maitam lou a kichiam peuhmah zaw maitam leh atung a om tengteng lou a kichiam ahi.
english: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it and by everything on it.

paite: Huan tempul lou a kichiam peuhmah zaw tempul leh asung a tengpa lou a kichiam ahi.
english: He who swears by the temple, swears by it and by him who has been living in it.

paite: Huan van lou a kichiam peuhmah leng Pathian laltutphah leh atung a tupa lou a kichiam ahi.'
english: He who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God and by him who sits on it.

paite: "Nou laigelhmi leh Pharisai lepchiahte aw, na tung uh agik hi; pudina, mohuri, zira sawm-a-khat na pia ua, dan khawkzaw, diktatna, zahngaihna, ginomna na limsak ngal kei uh; himahleh hiaite ei ve na hih ding uh, adangte hih lou tuan lou in.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. But you ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

paite: Nou makai mittawte, thousi khisiang a sangawngsau nawmvalhte aw!
english: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!

paite: "Laigelhmi leh Pharisai lepchiahte aw, na tung uh agik hi; nou leh kuang polam na hihsiang ua, asung lah lepgukna leh kideklouhna in adim uhi.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness.

paite: Nou Pharisai mittaw, nou leh kuang sunglam hihsiang masa un, apolam leng ahong siantheihna ding in.
english: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.

paite: "Laigelhmi leh Pharisai lepchiahte aw, na tung uh agik hi; hansuang nuhngou, polam a kilawmtak a kilang, asunglam misi guhte leh nin chiteng a dim bang na hi uh.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men’s bones and of all uncleanness.

paite: Nou leng huai bang in polam ah mihing mitmuh in diktattak in na kilang ua, na sunglam uh bel lepchiahna leh gitlouhna in na dim uhi.
english: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

paite: "Nou laigelhmi leh Pharisai lepchiahte aw, na tung uh agik hi; zawlneite han na lam ua, midiktat hante leng na zem uhi.
heading: Jesu'n Athuakna Ding Agenkholhna / (Luk 11.47-51)
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets and decorate the tombs of the righteous,

paite: I pipute dam lai a na om hi taleng, zawlneite sisan suahna ua pang lou ding hi hang a,' na chi uhi.
english: and say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we wouldn’t have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’

paite: Huchi in zawlneite thatte suante na hi uh chih na kitheisak uhi.
english: Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.

paite: Na pipute uh hih bang in sem zom tou ngal un.
english: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.

paite: Gulte leh gul suante aw, Gehenna vaihawmna bangchi in na pel thei ding ua?
english: You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna?

paite: Ngai dih ua, huaiziak mah in na kiang uah, zawlneite, mipilte, laigelhmite ka hon sawl ding; khenkhat na that ding ua, kros ah na kilhden ding uh, khenkhat na sinagogte uah savun khau in na zep ding ua, kho teng ah na sawi zel ding uhi.
english: Therefore, behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,

paite: Huchi in Abel midiktattak sisan a kipan, tempul leh maitam kikal a Barak tapa Zekariah na thah uh sisan tan in, leitung a midiktat sisan na suah tengteng uh noumau tung ah ahong tung ding hi.
english: that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the sanctuary and the altar.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, huai tengteng tu khang tung ah ahong tung ding hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.

paite: "Aw Jerusalem, Jerusalem, zawlneite that, na kiang ua ahon sawlte uh suang a na denglum a, akpi in anoute akha nuai a a-opkhum bang in na tate bangzah vei opkhum ka tum a, himahleh na ut kei uhi.
heading: Jerusalem Khopi Jesu'n Akahkhum / (Luk 3.34-35)
english: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not!

paite: En un, na inn uh avuak a taisan in a-omta hi.
english: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.

paite: K'on hilh ahi, 'Toupa min a hong pai ahampha hi, na chih masiah uh tuban na hon mu nawnta kei ding uh,’ " achi hi.
english: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”
